notes: Randomized interleaving, identical archived ranges and request sizes, concurrency one.
All expanded sorted posting bytes and field totals must match exactly.
Verification transfers are excluded from ingest elapsed time and reported separately.
Opaque R2 backend caches are uncontrolled. Native CPU must be joined from Cloudflare logs by CF-Ray.
limitations: 5 observations per range and variant; pilot sample, not production percentiles.
The bootstrap interval resamples within each range and variant; it does not account for systematic host differences, temporal effects, or represent full-corpus uncertainty.
Client latency includes uncontrolled remote I/O; CPU is measured separately by Cloudflare.
The source ranges and expanded posting bytes are identical. No cache warming assumption is used.
